command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: backup config"
sudo -n cp /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.bak.$(date +%s)

echo "STEP: set minlen and minclass"
sudo -n sed -i '/^\s*#\?\s*minlen\s*=/d;/^\s*#\?\s*minclass\s*=/d' /etc/security/pwquality.conf
printf 'minlen = 12\nminclass = 3\n' | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf >/dev/null

echo "STEP: verify config content"
grep -E '^(minlen|minclass)' /etc/security/pwquality.conf

echo "STEP: confirm pam invokes pwquality for password change"
grep -n pwquality /etc/pam.d/system-auth
grep -n pwquality /etc/pam.d/password-auth

echo "STEP: create test user for validation"
sudo -n useradd -m pwpolicytest 2>/dev/null || true

echo "STEP: test short password (should FAIL complexity)"
if printf 'Ab1defg\nAb1defg\n' | sudo -n passwd pwpolicytest 2>&1 | tee /tmp/short.log; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: short password accepted"
else
  echo "EXPECTED: short password rejected"
fi
grep -qi "short\|simple\|BAD PASSWORD\|too weak\|does not contain" /tmp/short.log && echo "PWQUALITY_REJECTED_SHORT=yes" || echo "PWQUALITY_REJECTED_SHORT=no"

echo "STEP: test long but only 2 classes (should FAIL)"
if printf 'lowercaseonlylongpass\nlowercaseonlylongpass\n' | sudo -n passwd pwpolicytest 2>&1 | tee /tmp/twoclass.log; then
  echo "UNEXPECTED: two-class password accepted"
else
  echo "EXPECTED: two-class password rejected"
fi
cat /tmp/twoclass.log

echo "STEP: test compliant password (12+ chars, 3 classes) (should PASS)"
if printf 'GoodPass123!\nGoodPass123!\n' | sudo -n passwd pwpolicytest 2>&1 | tee /tmp/good.log; then
  echo "EXPECTED: compliant password accepted"
else
  echo "UNEXPECTED: compliant password rejected"
fi
cat /tmp/good.log

echo "STEP: cleanup test user"
sudo -n userdel -r pwpolicytest 2>/dev/null || true

echo "DONE"

command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "STEP: recreate test user with known initial password"
sudo -n useradd -m pwpolicytest2 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'InitPass123!\nInitPass123!\n' | sudo -n passwd pwpolicytest2 >/tmp/init.log 2>&1
cat /tmp/init.log

echo "STEP: as non-root user, attempt short/low-class password change (EXPECT FAIL, enforced)"
set +e
printf 'InitPass123!\nAb1defgh\nAb1defgh\n' | sudo -n -u pwpolicytest2 passwd > /tmp/nonroot_short.log 2>&1
rc1=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/nonroot_short.log
echo "exit_code=$rc1"

echo "STEP: as non-root user, attempt long but 2-class password (EXPECT FAIL)"
set +e
printf 'InitPass123!\nlowercaseonlylongpass\nlowercaseonlylongpass\n' | sudo -n -u pwpolicytest2 passwd > /tmp/nonroot_twoclass.log 2>&1
rc2=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/nonroot_twoclass.log
echo "exit_code=$rc2"

echo "STEP: as non-root user, attempt compliant password (EXPECT SUCCESS)"
set +e
printf 'InitPass123!\nGoodPass456!\nGoodPass456!\n' | sudo -n -u pwpolicytest2 passwd > /tmp/nonroot_good.log 2>&1
rc3=$?
set -e
cat /tmp/nonroot_good.log
echo "exit_code=$rc3"

echo "STEP: summary"
echo "short_rejected=$([ $rc1 -ne 0 ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "twoclass_rejected=$([ $rc2 -ne 0 ] && echo yes || echo no)"
echo "compliant_accepted=$([ $rc3 -eq 0 ] && echo yes || echo no)"

echo "STEP: cleanup"

echo "DONE"
